currentCard.prompt: В каком году вышла игра Super Mario Bros., ставшая одной из ключевых для NES?

answers.note: Первую игру Super Mario Bros. проектировали на бумаге в клетку.
Space Invaders стала первой японской игрой, использовавшей микропроцессор.
В 1980 году Тору Иватани создал Pac-Man.
В Donkey Kong (1981) персонаж Марио носил имя Jumpman.

currentCard.explanation: The Strong датирует Super Mario Bros. 1985 годом. Nintendo называет её быстро ставшим мировым хитом среди игр Famicom; при запуске за пределами Японии система получила название Nintendo Entertainment System (NES). Правильный ответ — 1985 год.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The Strong L210 explicitly lists Super Mario Bros (1985). Nintendo UK L161 identifies SMB as a quickly worldwide smash hit and Famicom as renamed NES outsideJapan, grounding the prompt’s NES significance without borrowing that passage’s1984 section heading as an SMB release date. Nintendo Mario L63 also invokes1985 for earlyMario adventures, but is not used alone as a date proof. Correct slot0 is1985;1978/1980/1981 are earlier Space Invaders/Pac-Man/Donkey Kong milestones, real same-domain chronological distractors. Four uniformly formatted year labels fit В каком году equally.

Первую игру retains first, проектировали faithfully renders designed rather than programmed or printed, and бумаге в клетку is a natural, no-stronger Russian description of graph paper. The note does not invent a particular grid size, designer, level or entire production method. This concrete own-game development fact teaches something beyond the prompt/release-year key, replacing source-inclusion metadata. D1 resolved.

absoluteLevel.ground: Recognizing Mario widely is different from placing the original Super Mario Bros release in1985. People familiar with retro/NES history can reasonably distinguish it from Space Invaders, Pac-Man and Mario’s1981 Donkey Kong appearance; adults outside gaming mainly infer or guess. The question asks a major thematic milestone, not an obscure exact day or technical detail, so MEDIUM fits. Fame of Mario alone is not broad-adult EASY evidence.
absoluteLevel.directedDependencyCheck: Prompt, labels and numeric key identical; after-answer note0 changes no knowledge needed to choose1985. Own MEDIUM judgment remains applicable.
